name: SDIC Zhonglu Fruit Juice Co.,Ltd.
summary: SDIC Zhonglu Fruit Juice Co.,Ltd. produces and sells concentrated fruit and vegetable juices in China. It offers apple, pear, pulp, and other fruit and vegetable agricultural juice products; organic products; and decolorized and non-concentrated NFC juices. The company also exports its products to the United States, Japan, Europe, Australia, Canada, Russia, and internationally. SDIC Zhonglu Fruit Juice Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is based in Beijing, China.
